description: Start an image generation or edit job (pass image_urls to edit or combine images). Spends credits: check the cost with list_models. Returns a job id; follow up with get_job.

idempotency_key.description: Recommended: pass your own unique key (e.g. a UUID) and keep it. Retrying with the same key never charges twice, even if the first response was lost. Generated when omitted and returned in the result.

model.description: Image model id from list_models, e.g. "nano-banana", "gpt-image-2"

output_format.description: e.g. "png" or "jpeg", where the model supports it

name: generate_image
title: Generate image
